title: 选择纹眉工作室：从作品到到店设计
title_en: Choosing a brow studio: from work records to consultation
intro: 把作品看清楚，把设计依据和实际操作安排问清楚。选择纹绣工作室可以从这几件具体的事开始。
intro_en: Review the work carefully and ask how the design and procedure will be handled. These practical checks can help when choosing a studio.

sections.title: 作品能说明什么
sections.description: 整脸照片帮助看眉形与五官的关系，近照帮助看线条与毛流。只有明确标注恢复阶段的记录，才可以用于相应阶段的判断。
sections.description_en: Full-face images show the relationship between brows and features; close-ups show strokes and direction. Only records with a documented healing stage can support conclusions about that stage.

sections.title: 以骨相为基础，以眉形修饰五官
sections.title_en: Brow design grounded in bone structure and facial harmony
sections.description: 设计前，会综合观察五官的立体度、量感和整体风格，以及颧骨、眉眶骨的高低、眉眼关系和原生眉毛的生长方向。在尊重原有骨骼结构的基础上，通过调整眉头、眉峰、眉尾的位置、弧度与整体轮廓，修饰面部视觉比例，协调颧骨与眉眼之间的关系，让面部线条看起来更加流畅、舒展，并呈现更自然的立体感与折叠感。
sections.description_en: Before designing, she considers the depth, visual weight and overall character of the features, the height and prominence of the cheekbones and brow bone, the relationship between brows and eyes, and the direction of the existing brow hairs. Working with the existing bone structure, she adjusts the position and curvature of the brow start, arch and tail, along with the overall contour, to refine facial proportions visually and balance the relationship between the cheekbones and eye area. The aim is a smoother, more open visual flow, with natural depth and definition between facial planes.

sections.title: 人、护理与服务条款
sections.description: 确认实际设计与操作的人、恢复期如何安排，以及补色政策。描眉画目由乐乐老师本人一对一设计操作；免费设计约30–45分钟，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Confirm who designs and performs the work, how recovery will be managed and the touch-up policy. At Miaomeihuamu, Lele personally handles design and treatment, one client at a time. The free consultation takes about 30–45 minutes and all services include free touch-ups within one year.
